title: refactor(ci): simplify workflows, consolidate deps hygiene and optimize cache/parallelism
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Over time the .github workflows accumulated duplicated matrices, multiple node-version pins, and inconsistent cache keys. This PR consolidates and simplifies lint/test/release pipelines, bumps actions and a handful of dev dependencies for security hygiene, and standardizes cache keys and parallelism to reduce queue time and flakiness. Summary: - Split responsibilities across three focused workflows (lint, test, release) using reusable workflows where appropriate. - Normalize Node versions to node18 where consumer compatibility allows; leave specific integration jobs on node20 behind a feature flag. - Replace several in-repo matrix definitions with a single reusable matrix definition (.github/workflows/common/matrix.yml). - Unify cache keys for restore/save steps (actions/cache@v4) and reduce cache miss rates by including repo-specific and deps-hash components. - Bump GH Actions versions (actions/checkout, actions/setup-node, actions/cache) and a small set of devDeps (eslint, jest) for security/hygiene. - Improve test parallelism configuration for CI runners to avoid oversubscription of limited macOS and GPU runners. Implementation details: - Added .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml and moved shared logic into .github/workflows/reusable/common-ci.yml. - Updated package.json devDependencies: eslint@8.46.0 -> eslint@8.49.1, jest@29.5.0 -> jest@29.6.2 (only minor, no API changes). - Replaced hardcoded cache keys that used timestamp-based keys with deterministic keys that include package-lock/lockfile hash, and added fallback behavior when cache restore fails. - Introduced a small orchestration script scripts/ci/parallel-split.js to compute optimal job splits for large test suites (opt-in on repo root by setting CI_SPLIT=true). - Consolidated a few legacy GitHub Actions (deprecated uses of set-env and add-path) and removed a duplicated release action step that caused double-drafts for some tags. Testing & CI behavior observed during authoring: - Initial pipeline run: lint passed, unit tests failed on a flaky integration test that relied on an environment variable ordering; this was fixed by explicit ordering in test bootstrap and a follow-up commit. - Second pipeline run: all checks green except e2e which was flaky on an external service; we added a release-dry-run gating step and made e2e optional for canary merges. - Cache hit rate improved in synthetic runs from ~62% to ~88% for node module restores. Rollout and next steps: - Rolled out to main with a squash merge. Observability: added a short dashboard note to SRE runbook referencing ENG-3421. Follow-ups: - Replace remaining node20 jobs after infra upgrades (tracked in ENG-3499). - Evaluate opt-in of CI_SPLIT across additional repos and measure end-to-end median CI latency. Related: references SUP-1187 (support incident documenting CI timeouts) and a small internal doc link (internal.link/ci/cache-guidelines).

notes: This PR aims for minimal runtime behavior change to production artifacts — it only changes CI and dev tooling.
